before.name: Chuck Wiley
before.description: Chuck Wiley is a former Navy chief petty officer and nuclear engineer from Kentucky who served about 16 years in the U.S. military. While assigned to the USS Enterprise in 2006, he concluded that the Iraq War was unlawful and morally wrong. He left the Navy and moved to Canada in 2007 rather than continue participating. Canadian proceedings concerned his immigration status; available records do not document a U.S. arrest, court-martial or confinement.
